Through it runs the parish road, which--as it leads to the seashore, from whence the farmers of that and the neighboring parishes bring great quantities of sand and seaweed as manure--frequently presents, in the summer, a bustling scene.

Dearest, bury me  Under the holy-oak or gospel tree;... arxiv-1701-05020.title: Passive and active colloidal chemotaxis in a microfluidic channel: mesoscopic and stochastic models
arxiv-1701-05020.creator: Laurens Deprez, Pierre de Buyl
arxiv-1701-05020.description: Abstract Chemotaxis is the response of a particle to a gradient in the chemical composition of the environment. While it was originally observed for biological organisms, it is of great interest in the context of synthetic active particles such as nanomotors.

arxiv-1808-07042.title: CoQA: A Conversational Question Answering Challenge
arxiv-1808-07042.creator: Siva Reddy, Danqi ChenChristopher D. ManningComputer Science DepartmentStanford University {sivar,danqi,manning}@cs.stanford.edu
arxiv-1808-07042.description: Abstract Humans gather information through conversations involving a series of interconnected questions and answers. For machines to assist in information gathering, it is therefore essential to enable them to answer conversational questions. We introduce CoQA, a novel dataset for building Co nversational Q uestion A nswering systems. 1 1 1 CoQA is pronounced as coca .

arxiv-2208-08141.title: Sequential generalized measurements: Asymptotics, typicality and emergent projective measurements
arxiv-2208-08141.creator: Wen-Long Ma, Shu-Shen Li, Ren-Bao Liu
arxiv-2208-08141.description: Abstract The relation between projective measurements and generalized quantum measurements is a fundamental problem in quantum physics, and clarifying this issue is also important to quantum technologies. While it has been intuitively known that projective measurements can be constructed from sequential generalized or weak measurements, there is still lack of a proof of this hypothesis in general cases.

arxiv-2209-03053.title: Half-Quantized Hall Effect at the Parity-Invariant Fermi Surface
arxiv-2209-03053.creator: Jin-Yu Zou, Rui Chen, Bo Fu, Huan-Wen Wang, Zi-Ang Hu, Shun-Qing Shen
arxiv-2209-03053.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jin-Yu Zou, Rui Chen, Bo Fu, Huan-Wen Wang, Zi-Ang Hu, Shun-Qing Shen. Condensed matter realization of a single Dirac cone of fermions in two dimensions is a long-standing issue. Here we report the discovery of a single gapless Dirac cone of half-quantized Hall conductance in a magnetically-doped topological insulator heterostructure. It demonstrates that the Hall conductance is half-quantized in the unit e 2 / h e^{2}/h when the parity symmetry is invariant near the Fermi surface.

arxiv-2302-03420.title: Inadmissibility of invariant estimator of function of scale parameter of several exponential distributions lkpatra@iitbhilai.ac.in, patralakshmi@gmail.com
arxiv-2302-03420.description: Abstract In various applied areas such as reliability engineering, molecular biology, finance, etc., the measure of uncertainty of a probability distribution plays an important role. In the present work, we consider the estimation of a function of the scale parameter, namely entropy of many exponential distributions having unknown and unequal location parameters with a common scale parameter.

arxiv-2307-12430.title: Applying constraint programming to minimal lottery designs
arxiv-2307-12430.creator: David Cushing, David I. Stewart*
arxiv-2307-12430.description: Abstract . We develop and deploy a set of constraints for the purpose of calculating minimal sizes of lottery designs. Specifically, we find the minimum number of tickets of size six which are needed to match at least two balls on any draw of size six, whenever there are at most 70 70 balls. \lst@SaveOutputDef ‘_ \underscore@prolog 1.

arxiv-2309-06947.title: Spin glass theory and its new challenge: structured disorder
arxiv-2309-06947.creator: Marc Mézard
arxiv-2309-06947.description: Abstract This paper first describes, from a high level viewpoint, the main challenges that had to be solved in order to develop a theory of spin glasses in the last fifty years. It then explains how important inference problems, notably those occurring in machine learning, can be formulated as problems in statistical physics of disordered systems.

arxiv-2401-06809.title: Greedy Newton: Newton’s Method with Exact Line Search
arxiv-2401-06809.creator: Betty Shea, Mark Schmidt
arxiv-2401-06809.description: Abstract A defining characteristic of Newton’s method is local superlinear convergence within a neighbourhood of a strict local minimum. However, outside this neighborhood Newton’s method can converge slowly or even diverge. A common approach to dealing with non-convergence is using a step size that is set by an Armijo backtracking line search.

arxiv-2402-14984.description: Abstract The Gaia M dwarf gap, also known as the Jao Gap, is a novel feature discovered in the Gaia DR2 G vs. BP-RP color magnitude diagram. This gap represents a 17 percent decrease in stellar density in a thin magnitude band around the convective transition mass ( ∼ 0.35 ​ M ⊙ \sim 0.35M_{\odot} ) on the main sequence.

arxiv-2406-03711.title: Pi-fusion: Physics-informed diffusion model for learning fluid dynamics
arxiv-2406-03711.creator: Jing Qiu, Jiancheng Huang, Xiangdong Zhang, Zeng Lin, Minglei Pan, Zengding Liu, Fen Miao *
arxiv-2406-03711.description: Abstract Physics-informed deep learning has been developed as a novel paradigm for learning physical dynamics recently. While general physics-informed deep learning methods have shown early promise in learning fluid dynamics, they are difficult to generalize in arbitrary time instants in real-world scenario, where the fluid motion can be considered as a time-variant trajectory involved large-scale particles.

arxiv-2406-10496.title: Radiation RMHD accretion flows around spinning AGNs: a comparative study of MAD and SANE state
arxiv-2406-10496.creator: Ramiz Aktar, Kuo-Chuan Pan, Toru Okuda
arxiv-2406-10496.description: Abstract In our study, we examine a 2D radiation, relativistic, magnetohydrodynamics (Rad-RMHD) accretion flows around a spinning supermassive black hole. We begin by setting an initial equilibrium torus around the black hole, with an embedded initial magnetic field inside the torus.

arxiv-2502-07138.title: Towards a Robust Framework for Multimodal Hate Detection: A Study on Video vs. Image-based Content
arxiv-2502-07138.creator: Girish A. Koushik, Diptesh Kanojia, Helen Treharne
arxiv-2502-07138.description: Abstract . Social media platforms enable the propagation of hateful content across different modalities such as textual, auditory, and visual, necessitating effective detection methods. While recent approaches have shown promise in handling individual modalities, their effectiveness across different modality combinations remains unexplored.

arxiv-2505-23975.title: Molecular Dynamics Prediction of the Effect of Neutron Irradiation on the Ductile-to-Brittle Transition in Fe–Ni–Cr Alloys
arxiv-2505-23975.creator: A. Ustrzycka, H. Mousavi, F. J. Dominguez-Gutierrez, S. Stupkiewicz
arxiv-2505-23975.description: Abstract This study provides a comprehensive investigation into the fracture behavior of irradiated Fe–Ni–Cr alloys, focusing on the radiation-induced ductile-to-brittle transition (DBT). Unlike the commonly studied temperature-driven DBT, this transition is driven by radiation-induced defects, which impede dislocation motion and reduce the material’s capacity for plastic deformation, ultimately leading to brittle failure.

arxiv-2507-20055.title: A Tensor-Based Compiler and a Runtime for Neuron-Level DNN Certifier Specifications CCS: Software and its engineering Compilers

arxiv-2507-20055.description: Abstract . The uninterpretability of DNNs has led to the widespread adoption of abstract interpretation-based certification as a practical means to establish trust in real-world systems that rely on DNNs. However, the current landscape supports only a limited set of certifiers, and developing new ones or modifying existing ones to suit different applications remains difficult.

arxiv-2511-02061.title: GMCs and Star Formation in the Galaxy: I. Mass Loss from a GMC Induced by an HII Region
arxiv-2511-02061.creator: David Hollenbach, Antonio Parravano, Christopher F. McKee
arxiv-2511-02061.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Hollenbach, Antonio Parravano, Christopher F. McKee. We theoretically model the destruction of GMCs by HII regions, which evaporate ionized gas and eject neutral gas during their expansion.

Whilst effective psychosocial interventions exist, little is known about what key factors might modify the clinical decision to refer an individual to psychiatric in- and/or out-patient treatment following an episode of hospital-treated self-harm.

pmc-13373943.title: Psychiatric effects of cannabidiol, cannabinol, and tetrahydrocannabinol: A narrative review of clinical evidence and risk profiles
pmc-13373943.creator: Yasuhiro Kishi, Ichiro Takumi, Kakusho Chigusa Nakajima‐Ohyama
pmc-13373943.description: Cannabinoid products are increasingly used worldwide despite limited psychiatric evidence. This narrative review synthesizes preclinical and clinical evidence on cannabidiol (CBD), cannabinol (CBN), and tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) to clarify their distinct psychiatric profiles and discuss how current evidence may inform ongoing clinical and regulatory discussions.
